tasks.subject: Xero Task 1: DB schema — accounting_connection + accounting_sync_event
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the two tables that store Xero connection credentials and bill sync history per tenant.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/accounting_integration.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] accounting_connection table exists with all columns
- [ ] accounting_sync_event table exists with all columns
- [ ] RLS enabled on both with current_tenant_id() policy
- [ ] Unique partial index on (tenant_id, provider) where is_active

**Verify:** Run patch in Supabase SQL editor → \d accounting_connection shows all columns.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/accounting_integration.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase sql editor", "acceptanceCriteria": ["accounting_connection table exists", "accounting_sync_event table exists", "RLS enabled on both", "unique partial index"]}
```

tasks.subject: Xero Task 2: Xero OAuth lib — xero.ts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement buildXeroAuthUrl, exchangeXeroCode, refreshXeroToken, getXeroOrgs, createXeroBill as pure async functions.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/accounting/xero.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] buildXeroAuthUrl(state) returns valid Xero auth URL
- [ ] exchangeXeroCode(code) returns XeroTokenSet
- [ ] refreshXeroToken(refreshToken) returns XeroTokenSet
- [ ] getXeroOrgs(accessToken) returns XeroOrg[]
- [ ] createXeroBill returns InvoiceID string
- [ ] All functions throw on non-2xx responses

**Verify:** `npx tsx -e "import { buildXeroAuthUrl } from './src/lib/accounting/xero'; console.log(buildXeroAuthUrl('test'))"` → prints Xero URL.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/accounting/xero.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsx -e \"import { buildXeroAuthUrl } from './src/lib/accounting/xero'; console.log(buildXeroAuthUrl('test'))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildXeroAuthUrl works", "exchangeXeroCode works", "createXeroBill works"]}
```

tasks.subject: Xero Task 3: OAuth routes — install, callback, disconnect
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Three Next.js route handlers for the full Xero OAuth lifecycle.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/xero/install/route.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/xero/callback/route.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/xero/disconnect/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] /api/xero/install redirects admin to Xero auth page
- [ ] /api/xero/callback upserts accounting_connection, redirects to ?xero=connected
- [ ] /api/xero/disconnect deactivates connection, redirects to ?xero=disconnected
- [ ] State cookie prevents CSRF

**Verify:** npm run dev → Settings → Integrations → Connect Xero → Xero login opens.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/xero/install/route.ts", "src/app/api/xero/callback/route.ts", "src/app/api/xero/disconnect/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["install redirects to Xero", "callback creates accounting_connection", "disconnect deactivates connection"]}
```

tasks.subject: Xero Task 4: Push bill lib + goods-inwards trigger
tasks.description:
**Goal:** pushBillToAccounting() that creates a Xero bill from a delivery receipt, wired into createDeliveryReceipt.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/accounting/push-bill.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] No active connection → returns silently
- [ ] Expired token → refreshed before bill creation
- [ ] Lines with null cost_per_unit excluded
- [ ] Result logged to accounting_sync_event
- [ ] Receipt creation never fails due to push error

**Verify:** Create delivery receipt with costed line → check accounting_sync_event for status='synced'.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/accounting/push-bill.ts", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["push no-ops when no connection", "token refresh works", "bill created in Xero", "sync event logged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Xero Task 5: Settings UI — Xero connect panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Xero connect/disconnect panel with sync event history in Settings → Integrations.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/xero-manage.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/settings/integrations/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Disconnected: shows Connect Xero link
- [ ] Connected: shows org name, Disconnect button, last 5 sync events
- [ ] ?xero=connected/disconnected/error shows appropriate banner

**Verify:** npm run dev → Settings → Integrations → Xero section visible and functional.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/settings/integrations/xero-manage.tsx", "src/app/app/settings/integrations/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Xero section visible", "connect/disconnect works", "sync events shown"]}
```
